title: Hindko - Wikipedia
text: The term Hindko as used in Pakistan refers to speakers of Indo-Aryan languages who live among the primarily Iranian Pashtuns of the North-West Frontier Province (NWFP). The origins of the term refer merely to "Indian speaking" rather than to any particular ethnic group.

title: Hindko, Northern | Ethnologue Free
text: Northern Hindko is a stable indigenous language of Pakistan. It belongs to the Indo-European language family and is part of the Lahnda macrolanguage.

text: Hindko is an Indo-Aryan language spoken by around 5 million people in northwestern Pakistan. It is written in the Shahmukhi (developed from the Perso-Arabic) script.
